title: Mirror the Vault
mission: Turn the vault into its own reflection
briefing: The last trick of the blueprint wing: the guards' map is the mirror image of the real vault, and you need the real one. Clicking a room swaps its two corridors. Swap every room and the whole vault flips - which is all that mirror() does, one room at a time, all the way down. Auto will run the recursion for you, but it charges for every room it turns.
hints: Swapping a room's children does not change that room's height or how many rooms sit under it - only which side they are on.
A dead end has nothing to swap. Only rooms with at least one corridor below them count.
Mirroring reverses the inorder route. Mirror twice and you are exactly back where you started.
